output.reason: The brief uses an EA vs RD comparison and a tier-by-tier yield breakdown to separate the merit cuts from the portal delay, which makes a strong case that the scholarship schedule is the cause, and its next steps are concrete; still, the cut tiers are also the very files that got delayed, so some of the effect may be mixed together.
